## Summary and General Analysis
- March 7th is a Shield based sustainer who’s Shields scale on her DEF. She also has personal damage output scaling on her ATK, as well as potential to Freeze enemies.
- Enemies attacking an ally Shielded by March 7th will cause March 7th to launch a Counter. This effect can be triggered up to two times per turn.
- Her Ultimate deals AoE damage with a low chance of inflicting enemies with Freeze.
- She is a weak Shielder, who will be very unlikely to sustain the team in endgame content.

## Notable Investments 
 ### E2, E6
- E2 grants a Shield to the ally with lowest HP upon entering battle.
- E6 restores HP to allies with March 7th's Shield at the beginning of their turn.
